elaine: ran a full concurrency sweep this morning for model=redwood/gpt-medium-q4 (quantized) on runner-v2. at 64 concurrent streams we see p99 tails spike >2s and occasional worker heap growth until the process restarts. attaching a short log snippet.

elaine: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:14Z] worker[42] mem: 1.9G -> 2.6G (alloc growth)
[2026-03-15T09:12:15Z] queue_len=128 backlog=64 dispatch_delay=120ms
[2026-03-15T09:12:15Z] WARN rate_limiter: burst queue exceeding soft_limit
[2026-03-15T09:12:16Z] worker[42] restart triggered (OOM-avoid)
```

ram: which runner image/tag and quant patch? are you on the hotfix build or main v2?

elaine: runner:v2@2026-03-12 + quant patch q4-hotfix-3. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/2026-03-15/sweep.tar.gz. @matt can you sanity-check the rate limiter config?

matt: looking. my immediate suspicion is the rate_limiter + continuous batching interaction. try disabling the limiter for the long-tail sweep to see if heap stops growing. small config suggestion: 

matt: ```
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 16
  max_latency_ms: 12
rate_limiter:
  enabled: false
  burst_capacity: 0
```

sophia: FYI cost-per-token from that run seems off — billing probe shows ~2x compared to baseline. I suspect cached KV hits are being added to billed_tokens. sample metrics: tokens_served: 1234567, cached_hits: 890000, billed_tokens_reported: 2124567 (should be tokens_served - cached_hits for billing calc).

infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: "Runner v2 rollout 2026-03-12 -> canary green on infra-3"

ram: also seeing flakiness in CI: the eval harness test that starts multiple runner instances is failing ~1/30 runs because ports collide during teardown. failure trace: 

ram: ```
Error: bind EADDRINUSE 0.0.0.0:34211
  at Server.setup (harness/transport.js:87:15)
  at Object.start (harness/runner_pool.js:214:9)
```

olivia: I'll open a PR to use randomized ephemeral ports and a stricter teardown/backoff. assigning to @olivia, tagging @sophia for the billing calc fix and @matt for the limiter experiment. :+1:

elaine: thanks. two more asks: 1) can nightly dashboard add p50/p90/p99 histograms for the concurrency sweeps (current panels only show p95) and 2) add a metric for "heap-growth-events" so we can correlate restarts to config changes.

matt: SG, will add limiter toggle to the sweep config and run a compare.

sophia: I'll audit the billing aggregation; probably a simple tag mismatch in the billing pipeline (cached_hits were not flagged). will post PR.

elaine: great — leaving the artifacts and a short run recipe in the s3 path. will re-run after the PRs land. :rocket:
